title: Re-pin testing/critical-paths.md after CHG-040 widens the critical set

outcomes.statement: The reconciler accepts the regenerated twelve-rule testing/critical-paths.md through a new immutable CHG-044 migration layer, while unknown hashes continue to fail closed.
outcomes.demo: pnpm check:generated-guidance exits 0 on the regenerated bytes and the focused reconciler suite passes at its pre-layer count (41 passed, 35 subtests); reverting the layer reproduces the WR-adjacent failure 'unknown generated guidance state (sha256=2a3c897...)'.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the pin can be confined to the reconcile script, as CHG-044's filed acceptance criterion required.
uncertainties.resolution: It cannot. load_layered_overrides resolves each layer's desired artifact via contained_manifest_path(override_root, relative_path, ...), so a new layer must ship its own artifact and manifest.json under infra/scripts/overrides/CHG-044/2d93300/, exactly as CHG-042 did in ad2af90. The test harness pins the newest layer too (latest_desired_guide, copy_reconciler_data), so it moves with it. The filed criterion was written without reading the mechanism; the diff is scoped to the pin, which is what it was reaching for.

uncertainties.statement: Whether CHG-044 can be declared ready while it binds bytes that CHG-040's sync has to produce first.
uncertainties.resolution: The ordering is real but already discharged: CHG-040's sync ran and testing/critical-paths.md is at 2a3c897772877acdd9f0f97d521e692beb8b77f9c4e756dbbe93d81feb7f4f67 in this tree, which is the desired hash this layer pins. Declaring it as a blocked_by dependency would be inaccurate — the schema treats blocked_by as an ACTIVE blocker (WR_BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY) and there is no satisfied state — so the sequencing is recorded here instead of as a dependency edge.
